title: A room's owner can mute a participant or remove them from the call

tasks.title: Owner-only mute and remove endpoints, the removal window, and the token refusing removed users
verify: npm run test:integration -- api.moderation api.user-deleted db

tasks.title: The owner's tile menu, and what the muted and the removed see

acs.text: WHEN a room's owner calls `POST /api/v1/rooms/{roomId}/call/mute` with `{ participant, source }` (source one of microphone, camera, screen_share) THE SYSTEM SHALL mute that participant's track of that source through LiveKit's server API and answer 204
scenarios: AC-001 the owner mutes a microphone

acs.text: WHEN a room's owner calls `POST /api/v1/rooms/{roomId}/call/remove` with `{ participant }` THE SYSTEM SHALL remove the participant from the call through LiveKit's server API, answer 204, and keep them a member of the room
scenarios: AC-002 AC-003 the owner removes someone, who cannot rejoin for a while

acs.text: WHEN a removed user asks for a call token for that room within 15 minutes of removal THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 403 with error code `call.removed`
scenarios: AC-002 AC-003 the owner removes someone, who cannot rejoin for a while

acs.text: WHEN the caller is a member but not the owner THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 403; WHEN not a member, 404; WHEN calls are not available, 503 as for the token
scenarios: AC-004 only the owner may moderate

acs.text: WHEN `participant` is not `u:<id>` of someone currently in that room's call THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 404 and call nothing

WHILE the viewer owns the room THE SYSTEM SHALL show on every other participant's tile a menu with "Mute microphone", "Turn off camera", "Stop screen share" and "Remove from call" (each only when it applies), and to others no such menu
scenarios: AC-006 only the owner sees the tile menu

acs.text: WHEN a participant is muted by the owner THE SYSTEM SHALL tell them "The host muted you" and let them unmute themselves; WHEN removed, their window SHALL say "You were removed from the call" and they stay in the room
scenarios: AC-007 what the muted and the removed see
